core-values-review:
def resolve_timeout(value, default):
    return default if value is None or value == '' else int(value)
core-operators-review:
def batch_count(total, size):
    return (total + size - 1) // size
core-conditions-review:
def can_write(active, role, blocked):
    return active and role in ('admin', 'editor') and not blocked
core-sequences-review:
def tail_events(items, count):
    return items[-count:] if count else []
core-comprehensions-review:
def rank_jobs(jobs):
    return sorted(jobs, key=lambda job: job['priority'], reverse=True)
